title: fold-check harness verb has zero automated coverage — not in the 10 CI gates, no @(test)
evidence:
if verb == "fold-check" {
		if len(rest) != 2 {
			usage()
		}
		code := run_fold_check(rest[0], rest[1])
		os.exit(int(code))
	}

GATES=(
  "Purity + grep gates (ODN-1)|tools/lint.sh"
  "Core unit tests (the determinism + topology contracts)|odin test core"
  "Game builds (app.bin compiles + links)|odin build app -out:app.bin"
  "Golden harness (T1 hashes + T2 software pixels + replay gate)|tools/harness.sh run"
  "Sprite/palette presence scan (the look-book §2 palette oracle — 7.1)|tools/harness.sh palcheck"
  "W1 drift-rejection negative test|tools/harness.sh drift-check"
  "Assist preview cross-check (R2a preview == sim routing)|tools/harness.sh preview-check"
  "PP_DEBUG overlay builds (compile gate)|odin build app -define:PP_DEBUG=true -out:app-debug.bin && odin build harness -define:PP_DEBUG=true -out:bin/harness-debug"
  "Stats stream replay-identity (live == replay)|tools/harness.sh stats-check pause && tools/harness.sh stats-check qos_contention"
  "Input parity (T1 across inputs — mouse == touch == controller + CLI arg-validation leg)|tools/harness.sh input-parity && [ -x ./bin/harness ] && ! ./bin/harness input-parity bogus >/dev/null 2>&1"
)
detail: run_fold_check is new production code (3 exit-code paths: 0 PASS / 1 FAIL / 2 usage) with no test and no gate entry. It is the only re-runnable fold proof yet is itself ungated — a regression goes silent.
recommended_fix: Add a fold-check step to tools/ci-local.sh GATES (e.g. `tools/harness.sh fold-check <prev-hash> <prev-tick1>`) pinning the canonical pre-re-bless pair, so a future re-bless must pass it.

title: fold-check only steps tick 1 — does not prove the whole re-bless is fold-only
detail: The gate splices and verifies tick-1 only (era 0, static 3-node fixture). A non-fold shift manifesting at tick >= 2, era > 0, or in demand/growth passes. The remaining fold evidence (log byte-compare, T2 partition) is one-time PR prose, not re-runnable.
recommended_fix: Extend fold-check to step through the full boot window (ticks 1..N) and assert every spliced tick equals the prev golden's corresponding tick, or document the tick-1-only scope as a necessary-not-sufficient check.

title: PR-body fold-proof cites prev golden tick-1 `ab1fb0d04a90026c`; actual pre-re-bless tick-1 is `6c24e9cec592aece`
evidence:
- **Fold-only proof (boot):** the tick-1 state dump under the final code, with the previous hash spliced at the fold position (bytes 33..40), FNV-hashes to the previous golden tick-1 **exactly** (`ab1fb0d04a90026c`); the un-spliced dump hashes to the blessed tick-1 (`d1d2e53b7b1037ce`). The era-0/no-demand shift is the fold alone.

# git show aec3c88:goldens/boot.t1 -> "1 6c24e9cec592aece"  (catalog_hash 66c4324a06058860)
detail: `ab1fb0d04a90026c` is the INTERMEDIATE fold's tick-1 (hash 250679b1940fb87b, commit 11c6cf6), not the pre-re-bless golden. Running `harness fold-check 66c4324a06058860 ab1fb0d04a90026c` exits 1 (FAIL); the correct pair exits 0. Cause documentation is inconsistent.
recommended_fix: Correct pr-bodies/5.11.md:51 to `6c24e9cec592aece` (prev hash 66c4324a06058860), or explicitly label `ab1fb0d04a90026c` as the intermediate 250679b1940fb87b tick-1.

title: campus-half floor is a hardcoded literal 10 while EXPECTED derives from the catalog
evidence:
EXPECTED := i64(stream_entries) * i64(surge.multiplier) * i64(WINDOW) // 2×1×10×WINDOW = 20×WINDOW

testing.expectf(t, campus_window_spawns >= 10*WINDOW*95/100,
		"the campus half must land: in-window campus spawns %d < %d (10/tick × WINDOW × 0.95)", campus_window_spawns, 10*WINDOW*95/100)
detail: The total ask auto-derives from streaming entry volumes × multiplier, but the campus half hardcodes 10 (= campus vol 1 × multiplier 10). A future campus-volume or multiplier re-tune silently mis-pins the campus floor while EXPECTED self-corrects.
recommended_fix: Derive the campus floor from the campus entry's volume × surge.multiplier (same sum as EXPECTED, filtered to source_role == .Campus), eliminating the literal 10.

title: Advisory test gate: CONCERNS
detail: P0 100% (demand/growth/surge pins fully exercised by `odin test core` gate 2; palcheck pins by gate 5). P1 ~90%. Overall >=80%. Gaps: fold-check verb has 0% automated coverage and a wrong-hash PR citation.
recommended_fix: Wire fold-check into ci-local.sh GATES with the pinned pre-re-bless pair; correct pr-bodies/5.11.md:51 hash; widen the splice to ticks 1..N.
